text:
**Risk flags:**  
- Single shareholder holds 89.67%

**Overview:**  
Global Everbright Store Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retailer based in Kuala Lumpur, specializing in textiles and *baju kurung*. The company was incorporated on 1990‑10‑28 and was formerly known as Sinar Industries Sdn. Bhd. (name change on 2025‑06‑25). It operates with three directors and a dominant shareholder who owns 89.67% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM 17,700,737; RM 18,056,230; and RM 19,374,478 across the three most recent financial entries, with equity of RM 11,706,190; RM 11,990,501; and RM 12,321,741. The firm has been involved in five legal cases, none as a defendant.
